limitations: All results concern the infinite binary Thue–Morse factor language. General class inflation requires \(n\ge4\); the closed dyadic orbit spectrum is established only for lengths \(2^k\) with \(k\ge2\). No independent mathematical or comprehensive historical-priority audit has been performed.
scientific_integrity: The general length-doubling class-size multiset identity and dyadic orbit-size classification are supported by the written parity/matching proof; finite tests are corroboration only. The numerical dyadic cyclic-complexity formula was published earlier and is not claimed as novel.
title: Conjugacy-class inflation and the dyadic orbit-size spectrum of the Thue–Morse word
